The AFT doesn't consider something a "Firearm" (gun, rifle, pistol whatever) unless it is sold in more than 80% complete form. So there's a market out there for "80% complete" items (I know of AR-15 and Glock, I know you can DIY an AK47 as well, but not sure if there are 80% units) that have no serial, no registration... they are basically "ghosts". The person who purchases can get it through the mail, no FFL, no Gov records, finish the last 20% and assemble with the rest of the parts. The other parts are just that too, parts, not considered "firearm" so also not tracked or regulated.

That means that ANYONE with the desire can build their own. These never receive serial numbers, and thus simply can't be tracked. Of course, they are also for personal use too and you're asking for a whole lot of Feds raiding your property should you try to manufacture them for resale... but it's something everyone who's serious about being "prepared" should do.
